title: FRED market macro signals (futures programme, track 1b)
data: research_data/fred: DGS10, DGS3MO (H.15 yields), BAA10Y (Moody's Baa - 10y), DFII10 (10y TIPS real yield), T10YIE (10y breakeven). Market series, not revised. Value of day t used from the close of the next trading day t+1 (FRED publishes H.15 with a one-day lag).

trials.M1 curve slope -> Treasuries: slope = DGS10 - DGS3MO; z = (slope - 756-day rolling mean) / 756-day sd; ZN and ZB position = clip(z, -1, 1) each (steep curve = high term premium -> long duration; Fama-Bliss / Campbell-Shiller)
trials.M2 credit spread -> equities: long ES and NQ (0.5 each) while BAA10Y fell over the last 21 days, flat otherwise (credit leads equity; long-only timing, beta allowed by the programme)
trials.M3 real-yield momentum -> gold: GC position = -sign(21-day change of DFII10) (falling real yields -> long gold)
trials.M4 breakeven momentum -> commodities: CL, HG, GC position = sign(63-day change of T10YIE) each (rising inflation expectations -> long real assets)

sizing: position x 0.10 / (60-day realised vol, lagged), cap 3; equal-weight across the markets of a trial; futures_db costs; daily roll-safe returns
judge: each entrant alone added to the 15-sleeve book: 2023-26 >= 1.218 + 0.05 and 2010-17, 2018-22 not lower; all entrants together reported
promotion: never without the user's explicit OK
